name: Signify N.V.
summary: Signify N.V. provides lighting products, systems, and services in Europe, the Americas, and internationally. It operates through Professional, Consumer, OEM, and Conventional segments. The company offers LED products and connected lighting systems and services, including functional LED luminaires, LED and conventional lamps and tubes, and lighting components such as LED drivers, electronics, modules, and sensors.
